Panpour

Water

Unova · Generation 5

Panpour is a Water-type Spray Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 13.5 kg. It evolves into Simipour. Its highest base stat is Speed (64), with a base stat total of 316.
